What's standing in your way?

Growing teams, growing pains. Let's tackle them together.

You want top talent. So does everyone else.

As your company grows, standing out is key. Staying visible and appealing to top candidates can determine how fast you reach your goals. Engage talent wherever they are, with an experience matching your brand.

Too many systems, too little time.

Recruitment moves fastest when everyone's aligned. Instead of juggling spreadsheets and scattered tools, your team needs one space to work together, ensuring every candidate moves forward smoothly.

Clear data means confident decisions.

The more you scale, the more data you have. But data is only useful if it helps your team see what’s working and where to adapt. With clear, actionable analytics, your hiring decisions move from gut feeling to real confidence.

Let your team focus on people, not paperwork.

Your teams win by focusing on meaningful candidates, not busywork. Streamlining tasks like scheduling interviews, reviewing resumes, and candidate communications frees up space for what really matters.

Meet Tellent Recruitee, a better way to hire.

Let your brand do the talking.

Put your values front and center. Build a careers page that showcases who you are, no code required. Tell your story with custom layouts, team stories, and visual details that attract candidates who fit right in.

Deliver a great candidate experience.

Treat every applicant like a future teammate with automated updates, personalized communication, and a smooth application process. Tellent Recruitee helps you leave a positive, lasting impression.

Customize your hiring process.

Make every step fit your way of working. Tailor workflows, evaluation forms, candidate pipelines, and more, so your recruitment process reflects your goals, your team, and your company culture. Flexibility for any role, every time.

Collaborate as one team, wherever you are.

Make hiring decisions based on clear data.

With real-time data and clear dashboards, you always know what’s working, what needs attention, and how to improve. So you can fill roles faster with the right talent.

Keep it simple and compliant.

Hiring in new markets? Tellent Recruitee helps you stay fully compliant with local laws and GDPR. So you can hire with a total peace of mind.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Tellent Recruitee?

Tellent Recruitee is a customizable, easy-to-use Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and recruitment software that helps recruitment teams hire faster, stay aligned, and make better hiring decisions — all in one place.

It covers the full recruitment journey: building your careers site, posting jobs, screening candidates, collaborating with hiring managers, sending offer letters, and handing off new hires to your HRIS. Trusted by 7,000+ companies and 180,000+ daily users across 120+ countries.

Who is Tellent Recruitee built for?

Tellent Recruitee is built for growth-stage and mid-market organizations, typically between 50 and 1,000 employees, at the point where hiring is accelerating, and informal processes no longer keep up.

It's used by two main groups: business leaders in smaller organizations who own hiring without a dedicated HR function, and growing People and Talent teams — recruiters, hiring managers, and Heads of HR, People, or Recruitment — who need everyone working from the same process.

If you're managing multiple open roles, coordinating with hiring managers, and trying to build a consistent, scalable process, Tellent Recruitee is built for you.

What hiring challenges does Tellent Recruitee solve?

Most teams come to Tellent Recruitee with one or more of these problems:

  • Hiring scattered across spreadsheets and inboxes
  • Hiring managers giving feedback late — or not at all
  • No visibility into where candidates stand at any given moment
  • Too much time lost to admin and repetitive manual tasks
  • No reliable way to show hiring impact to leadership
  • Slow or impersonal candidate communication — candidates left waiting, responses are generic
  • Hiring decisions based on gut feeling, not data

Tellent Recruitee brings structure, automation, and collaboration into one place, so your team spends less time managing the process and more time on the people.

Does Tellent Recruitee integrate with my existing tools?

Yes. Tellent Recruitee connects with 200+ tools via the Tellent Marketplace — including HRIS platforms, calendars (Google, Outlook), video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet), job boards, LinkedIn, and more.

For custom setups, you can also use the API and webhooks to build exactly the integrations your team needs.

Browse integrations on the Tellent Marketplace →

Can Tellent Recruitee replace spreadsheets and manual email processes?

Yes, and that's what it's purposefully built for. Tellent Recruitee brings everything into one place — candidate data, hiring manager feedback, interview scheduling, team communication, job posting and promotion, and reporting — so nothing gets lost across spreadsheets, inboxes, and shared drives.

Everyone works from the same information, and repetitive steps are automated. In a survey of our customers, 94% reported significantly fewer manual tasks after switching to Tellent Recruitee.

How much does Tellent Recruitee cost?

Pricing is based on the plan you choose (Start, Advance, or Optimize), your organization's size, and your billing period. Paying annually gives you a 20% discount. All plans require a minimum one-year commitment, with the option to pay monthly.

To get a price tailored to your team, book a 30-minute demo or visit our pricing page to see our plans and packaging. Want to build a business case first? Use our ROI calculator to estimate your potential savings.

How is Tellent Recruitee different from other ATSs?

Here's what sets us apart:

  • Unlimited users on all plans: no per-seat pricing that discourages collaboration
  • Built around your process, not the other way around: customize pipelines, workflows, templates, and settings to match how your team already hires
  • Fully branded candidate experience: your careers site runs on your own domain, with no vendor branding in candidate touchpoints
  • Built in Europe, compliant globally: GDPR at its core, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, with support for EEOC in the US
  • Native WhatsApp integration: candidates can apply and communicate via WhatsApp, with no third-party tool required
  • A platform people actually want to use: no IT or training required; intuitive enough for hiring managers, powerful enough for recruiters
  • Part of Tellent's modular People Decision Platform: start with recruiting, and add Core HR and performance management when you're ready, all on the same system
